name: BRCA1 associated deubiquitinase 1

function.text: BAP1 encodes a deubiquitinase involved in chromatin regulation and other cellular processes, including regulation of transcription and DNA-damage responses.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to BAP1-related tumor predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mesothelioma; Uveal melanoma; Meningioma, CNS WHO grade 3. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
